name: tivachat-intent-hashed-linear-10m
architecture: signed feature hashing (unigram + bigram + char 3-5 grams) -> linear softmax
notes: 10,000,000 slots are addressable, not informative: with ~17k examples only a small fraction become non-zero after int8 quantization.
Raising capacity cannot replace data. Before shipping a 10M model, collect >=100k real, non-template Persian utterances with held-out speakers.
Always report template-held-out accuracy AND a hand-written novel test set. Do not claim 100% accuracy from synthetic templates.
The shipping APK must stay small: 10M int8 weights = 10 MB, which is >25x the current 3.9 MB model and adds no measurable accuracy at this data size.
